title: Reservation
wikitext:
{{redirect|Reservation Efficiency|the small passive skill node|Reservation Efficiency (passive skill)}}
[[Image:Mana reservation.png|thumb|upright|Reserved mana is shown grey on the mana orb.]]

'''Reservation''' is a method of using a resource, typically [[mana]] or [[life]], to pay for [[aura]]s, [[herald]] skills, buffs, [[mine]] skills, or any skill with an ongoing effect. Some items may also reserve resources. Rather than paying the cost once as with normal skills, a portion of the resource is set aside as unusable for as long as the skill is active. Reserving a resource does not affect its maximum, so percentage modifiers such as {{c|mod|Regenerate 1% of Maximum Life}} are unaffected when you reserve life, for example.

Reserved resource values from Skills are multiplied by [[support gem]] cost & reservation multipliers as usual. The [[Blood Magic]] Keystone and {{il|Arrogance Support}} will cause skills that usually reserve Mana to reserve Life instead.

__TOC__

==Reservation Efficiency==
Reservation Efficiency (RE) is a modifier that can modify the reservation of one or several Skill reservations. The total of all {{c|mod|Increased Reservation Efficiency}} modifiers whether from [[passive]]s, [[jewel]]s, or [[item]]s, is summed before being applied. It uses the following formula:

{{math|formula= 
\text {Resource Reserved} = \dfrac {\text {Base Reserve }\%} {100\% + \text{Total Reserve Efficiency }\%}
}}

{| class="wikitable"
|+ Example Reservations
|-
! Increased Reservation Efficiency !! [[Essence Worm|-80%]] !! [[Vivinsect|-20%]] !!0% !! 25% !! 50% !! 75%!!100%!!150%!!200%
|-
| 10% Reservation Skill || 50% || 13% || 10% || 8% || 7% || 6% || 5% || 4% || 4%
|-
| 25% Reservation Skill  || 125% || 32% || 25% || 20% || 17% || 15% || 13% || 10% ||9%
|-
| 35% Reservation Skill  || 175% || 44% || 35% || 28% || 24% || 20% || 18% ||14% || 12%
|-
| 50% Reservation Skill  || 250% || 63% || 50% || 40% || 34% || 29% || 25% || 20% || 17%
|}

Reservation multipliers such as that granted by {{il|Enlighten Support}} are multiplicative with reductions from Reservation Efficiency. Modifiers to [[cost]], such as {{il|Inspiration Support}} and {{c|mod|Elreon's}} mod will '''not''' have any effect on reservation.

A reduced reservation efficiency of 100% or higher would cause skills to have infinite reservation, making the player unable to use any reservation skills.

[[Blessing skill]]s can remove an aura's reservation, with some caveats.

Reservation Efficiency does not affect reservation effects that do not come from a skill, such as {{il|Midnight Bargain}} and {{il|Blood Price}}

==Unique items==
These [[unique item]]s affect reservation efficiency:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=(item_stats.id LIKE "%reservation_+%"
    OR item_stats.id LIKE "%reservation_efficiency_+%"
    OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Reservation%Efficiency%"
    OR items.stat_text LIKE "%No%Reservation%")
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE  "%Preservation%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
|orderby=name ASC
}}

Note that although {{il|Megalomaniac}} may have mods which grant passive skills that affect Reservation, the mods themselves are not directly granting RE.

==Skills which reserve mana==
[[Mana]] can be reserved in three ways:
* By a flat amount, which grows with gem level
* By a percentage of maximum mana, which does not change with gem level
* By a percentage of maximum mana, which changes with gem level

===Percentage reservation===
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables = skill_levels
|join = skill._pageID=skill_levels._pageID
|where = skill_levels.mana_reservation_percent > 0
|level=yes
|int=yes
|dex=yes
|str=yes
|mana=yes
}}

* {{sl|id=Envy}}
* [[Aspect]] skills:
** {{sl|Aspect of the Avian}}
** {{sl|Aspect of the Cat}}
** {{sl|Aspect of the Crab}}
** {{sl|id=AspectOfTheSpider}}
** {{sl|Aspect of the Brine King}}
** {{sl|Aspect of Solaris}}
** {{sl|Aspect of Lunaris}}
** {{sl|Aspect of Arakaali}}
* {{sl|Herald of the Hive}}

===Flat reservation===
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables = skill_levels
|join = skill._pageID=skill_levels._pageID
|where = skill_levels.mana_reservation_flat > 0
|level=yes
|int=yes
|dex=yes
|str=yes
|mana=yes
}}

* {{il|Blastchain Mine Support}}
* {{il|High-Impact Mine Support}}

Note that skills supported by {{il|Arrogance Support}} or socketed in {{il|Prism Guardian}} reserve Life instead of Mana.

==Life Reservation==
By default, all gems reserve mana instead of life. No skill gems reserve life, however life can be reserved using the following methods:
* {{sl|Blood Sacrament}}
* {{sl|Thirst for Blood}}
* [[Blood Magic]] keystone passive skill
* {{il|Arrogance Support}} (formerly known as Blood Magic Support)
* unique items (read table below)

===Related unique items===
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Reserve%Life%instead%Mana%" OR
items.stat_text LIKE "%Blood Magic%" OR
items.stat_text LIKE "%Arrogance%" OR
items.stat_text LIKE "%random Support Gem%" OR
items.name LIKE "%Midnight%Bargain%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

Note: items with a flat amount of reservation as a modifier cannot have their reservations modified by any sources of reservation efficiency.

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* Reservation effects such as Heralds and Auras now persist through death, allowing you to get right back into combat as fast as possible.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* The costs and reservations system for skills has been extensively reworked to add new options. (See {{Section link|Version 3.16.0|Support characters - Auras and other Reservation Effects}} for a full explanation of these changes.)
** Modifiers that granted increased/decreased Reservation cost have been replaced with Reservation Efficiency. Reservation Efficiency works by dividing the cost of the Reservation Effect.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.14.0|
* The costs and reservations system for skills has been extensively reworked to add new options. (See {{Section link|Version 3.14.0|Character Balance}} for a full explanation of these changes.)
** Percentage reservations are now stored with more precision internally, allowing them to have up to two decimal places in the percentage value, however the total amount of resources reserved must still be a whole number. This prevents some cases where small reductions in reservation values would have no effect due to rounding.
** Reserving Mana or Life no longer involves spending anything - skills can be reserved as long as you have enough unreserved Mana or Life, and do not need to pay the same amount of your current Mana or Life as a cost. However, some skills may have both a cost and reservation amount, such as Mine skills.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.9.2b|
* Fixed a bug where the "{{c|mod|x% reduced Mana Reserved}}" Redeemer influence modifier was able to be on the same item as the same modifier from Shaper influence or Fossils.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.7|
* Mana reservation mechanic added to the game with nine player aura skills: {{il|Anger}}, {{il|Hatred}}, {{il|Wrath}}, {{il|Discipline}}, {{il|Grace}}, {{il|Determination}}, {{il|Purity}}, {{il|Haste}} and {{il|Vitality}}.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
